title: Richmond upon Thames Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline readiness guide for hospital A&E, urgent treatment centres, supply corridors, and flood hazards in Richmond upon Thames.
content: For immediate, life-threatening medical emergencies, dial 999 or 112 before doing anything else. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: West Middlesex University Hospital, Twickenham Road, Isleworth, TW7 6AF. From Twickenham Station: ~20 min walk north along London Road and Twickenham Road, or bus 267; from Richmond Station: bus H37 or R68 west towards Isleworth. Kingston Hospital, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7QB. From Teddington Station: ~25 min walk south across Kingston Bridge via Kingston Road, or bus 281 or 285. St George's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Teddington Memorial Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Hampton Road, Teddington, TW11 0JL. From Teddington Station: ~10 min walk west along Broad Street and Hampton Road. 3. Local Hazards: River Thames tidal flooding along both north and south riverbanks, frequently inundating roads and towpaths in Richmond, Barnes, Kew, Mortlake, and Twickenham during astronomical spring tides; River Crane and Beverley Brook local flood plains. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and major grocery retailers along George Street in Richmond, King Street in Twickenham, Broad Street in Teddington, and Barnes High Street supply emergency rations, clean water, and medical essentials. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
